name: Kambiz Borna
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart 2014 accepted abstracts, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Kambiz Borna as an author of “Geographical vector agents for supervised image classification”.
Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Kambiz Borna as an author of “Extracting city objects with vector agents”.
GeoCart 2024 session 2 programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Kambiz Borna as an author of “Human-centred Cartographic Design”.
SIRC NZ 2013 GIS and remote sensing proceedings citations, University of Otago lists Kambiz Borna as an author of “Geographical vector agent modelling for image classification”.
